changelog:
Initial release of skill-tailwind: A comprehensive, framework-agnostic guide and toolkit for correctly implementing Tailwind CSS v4.

- Covers writing, configuring, migrating (v3→v4), and reviewing Tailwind v4 CSS in any stack.
- Documents both organizing approaches: utility-first classes vs. BEM + @apply in SCSS.
- Includes dense reference materials, in-depth conceptual guides, component examples, templates, cheat sheets, workflows, scripts, and evals.
- Focuses on technical correctness, including design token mapping, dark mode, states, accessibility, and responsive design.
- Excludes design direction, color/value selection, JS component behavior, and non-Tailwind/general CSS topics.
